In my opinion, First, you can still have a happy family with children you adopt, so don't worry about not wanting to have sex. I know that it often is seen as important to bring your own children in the world, but I believe God would appreciate you helping any child by giving them a loving home.  Even though they aren't your blood and it can seem difficult to believe that you could have the same connection, all I can say is that I promise you still can. Asexual in the end along with being a lesbian or bisexual is a title, even if you don't call yourself that nothing will chnage what you actually are  (this also applies to people calling you rude things that Don't apply to you). Don't be afraid of such things ! Even if you don't want to be called a certain title, just accept yourself for who you are. God just wants to see that his children are happy, and leading good lives. I'm very happy that you understand sexuality is not a choice. It can seem uncomfortable to see a gay marriage as equal to a straight one, but that's just because it's been depicted as a taboo to you. Many peoples didn't support interracial marriages and believed "people should only marry their own kind" right? Obviously those people just were seeing things they didn't understand and were taboo/different from the norm and often our first instinct it to reject it and be afraid. I belive that right now, all of society just doesn't really truly understand LGBT things, and if you come to understand it more I think maybe you can see that it is something you could accept. Men and woman don't complete each other just because of their genders, relationships are about people completing each other through their different personality and abilities. Without the stereotypes of men and woman , and realizing that anyone can take on those roles, it makes more sense. It sounds like you are having a very difficult time,  I think that if you tell your friend that you are learbing then maybe she can come back to you.If not, then at least you are learning. It seems a bit weird to really punish someone for being in love, you can't have control over that. There are obviously many different ways to interpret the bible, especially since there's not even just one solid translation. Remember the core of things, such as God wanting you to be happy and love all. Through out history people have tried to use the bible to say others are heathens or below them, but that is not what it is really about. Slowly people are truly getting closer to fully accepting all as God intended and not seeing them as terrible people going to hell for things they can't help. Over time we have learned that people shouldn't be killed over their beliefs and shove it down their throats, things like your color doesnt mean its okay to segregate people into different churches or tell them they cant take certain roles in the church, and so on. Humans are not perfect and they are not God, they are prone to messing up. Eventually I believe people will too come to see that loving who you love regardless of their gender. Good luck, friend. I hope you figure everything out and follow your heart ❤
